name: atlas-viewer
title: Atlas viewer
description: The Atlas viewer: an app's catalogue of screens and states as `boring-ui-blocks atlas … --out` shot them, from the shoot's index. The states grouped by flow, each arrow labelled with the state's `after`; a phone (390) or desktop (1280) and light or dark switch; the « changed » and « new » badges of `--since`; a click opens one shot large in a dialog. Props in (the index and where the shots are), no fetch; English by default, French by setting, labels overridable. Needs the shadcn `badge`, `button`, `dialog`, `separator` and `toggle-group` components.
